task.name: drag_basket_place_cube_ep1
task.description: Use the right gripper to drag the basket to the center of the table, then use the left gripper to grasp and place the blue cube into the basket.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right gripper to approach and align with the basket.
2. Grasp the basket with the right gripper.
3. Drag the basket to the center of the table using the right gripper.
5. Move the left gripper to approach and align with the blue cube.
6. Grasp the blue cube with the left gripper.
7. Move the left gripper to align with the basket.
8. Release the left gripper to place the blue cube into the basket.
